_comment: A relieved regiment backs out of the line facing the enemy. A tired player Infantry unit (uid0) holds an engaged enemy while a fresh one (uid1) waits behind it; the player box-selects the fresh unit and right-clicks the engaged ally at tick 200 -- a RELIEF order. The reliever takes over the fight and the relieved unit peels back to its own rear. Watch uid0's heading: it stays fronted on the enemy for the whole withdrawal instead of pivoting 180 degrees and marching off, so the slot grid never sweeps through a half-turn the soldier bodies cannot follow. TIMING IS LOAD-BEARING: the right-click must land AFTER the enemy reaches the tired unit, because a right-click on a friendly that is not yet fighting resolves to a plain ground MOVE instead of a RELIEF -- there is nothing to relieve yet. With centre-to-centre contact ranges contact came around tick 128; with the front-rank reach MeleeFrontLine adds, the 100 wu spawn gap between uid0 and uid2 is already contact, and the two are FIGHTING by the first sample (tick 8). KNOWN STAGING DEFECT (#1840): the tick-30 box [700,350]..[900,430] also takes in uid0's rear ranks (y about 407-425), so both player units are selected and no RELIEF forms on any platform.

overlap.reason: The relieved unit peels out of a still-pressed melee; one judged sample catches bodies closer than the infantry overlap threshold while it is leaving the fight. Merge-base of this clip already failed overlap on uid0; the facing pin this edit updates is a separate, passing expect. uid1 (the fresh unit) dips to nnd_min 1.14 wu against its 2.25 wu floor at ticks 337-361 and 393-411 on this tree's own seed (2-tick samples), and below that floor on the declared state ticks too: the tick-30 box also takes in uid0's rear ranks (y about 407-425), so both player units are selected and no RELIEF forms, on every platform (selection is position math). On the merge-base a3714751 the blocks close to y 489 and 515 before the tick-200 click, which lands on the enemy and becomes an ATTACK; on this tree they are in contact from the spawn (the 100 wu gap is inside the front-rank reach) and hold at y 469 and 585, so the click lands on uid0 and both selected units take a ground MOVE to (800, 470), which walks uid1 into the back of its fighting ally. The merge-base passes at 5.22 wu on this seed and dips to 0.11 wu on perturbed seed 3 (one of four); this tree dips below the floor on two of the four (0.19, 1.27). #1840 tracks the staging (the box and the spawn gap); remove uid1 here with it.
